name: courtside-desktop
description: Courtside fantasy basketball analytics for macOS and Windows
author: Courtside

scripts.start: npm run build:web && npm run copy:web && electron .
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:web && npm run copy:web && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:web && npm run copy:web && electron-builder --mac dmg
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build:web && npm run copy:web && electron-builder --dir
